description: Charming, affordable Lloyd Thola-built rambler in highly desirable Emerald Heights neighborhood in Lacey! Ideally located near Capitol City Golf Club, parks, shopping, restaurants, schools, everyday amenities & with easy access to JBLM, this move-in-ready home offers comfort, style & exceptional value. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout the open-concept floor plan, creating a warm & inviting living space filled with natural light. The updated kitchen (2023) features stunning granite countertops, full-height tile backsplash, recessed lighting & included stainless steel appliances, making it perfect for everyday living & entertaining. Vaulted ceilings & bay windows enhance a spacious feel throughout the home. Both bathrooms were tastefully remodeled (2023), including updated primary 3/4 bath with new shower stall & heads, while new light fixtures throughout provide a fresh, modern touch. Stay comfortable in every season with efficient ductless mini-split heating & A/C. Step outside to enjoy the large fully-fenced backyard featuring an expansive patio that's ideal for BBQs, gatherings, or relaxing evenings, plus an irrigation system to keep the landscaping looking its best.
